name: How does the design-build process work for an accessible kitchen renovation with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: How does the design-build process work for an accessible kitchen renovation with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our integrated design-build process begins with an in-depth consultation to understand your specific accessibility needs and vision. We then move into design planning, utilizing CAD-supported layouts to create a detailed plan for your accessible kitchen. Following design approval and permit coordination, our experienced team manages all aspects of construction, installation, and final walkthrough. This seamless approach ensures a single point of coordination, allowing us to harmonize design vision with construction execution and deliver a high-quality, customized renovation from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our design-build process covers consultation, CAD-supported design planning, permit coordination, construction, and final walkthrough, providing a single point of coordination for your accessible kitchen.
